Nine comments

Anyone ?

From a Miltown session, 1986 or thereabouts, with Frankie Kennedy{RIP}, Mairead Mooney and a crowd from Belfast. Transcribed for me by Malcolm Reavell. This may be here already, but nothing came up from an “Advanced” search. Anyone have a name for it, or know anything about it ? For some reason, I’m thinking Josie Keegan.

↳ Posted by Kenny on September 3rd, 2005.

It seems to me to be a reel version of this jig:

https://thesession.org/tunes/2632

Although the reel version I’ve heard is a bit different to this. Don’t know it well, and I don’t think I’ve a recording of it. But I have heard it in Belfast.

↳ Posted by Sláine on September 6th, 2005.

Could be

You could well be right with that continuo - definite similarities there. Thanks.

↳ Posted by Kenny on September 6th, 2005.

"[This] is a reel version of the jig Brennan’s Favourite. This reel version came from the creative mind of Belfast fiddle player Andy Dickson, who played fine music with Dermy Diamond in the eighties and who is still playing away at sessions in the city today. I don’t know what name Andy gave the tune, but as I learned it from him, I call it after it’s creator- so Andy Dickson’s it is.

# Posted on May 1st 2007 by red diesel

Name change

Since it was Andy Dickson who “de-composed” “Richard Brennan’s” jig to give this reel, - according to “red diesel” - see above - I’ll give it the title “Andy Dickson’s’”.

↳ Posted by Kenny on May 29th, 2008.

Conan said he’d e-mailed A.D. a while back to ask him if he’d given it a title, but I don’t know if he ever got a reply.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on May 29th, 2008.
